verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs say you can run all of Sentry on your own server for free, via an official self-hosted setup it maintains, and a long-term user reports the self-hosted version is rock-solid once running. There are real operational caveats: the setup comes with no guarantees or support, the founder concedes it is 'awful today to self-host', and users report growing container and memory demands. missing for 10: official support or guarantees for self-hosted, a lighter-weight deployment footprint, documentation on running it reliably at scale.
